tei:div.tei:p: skabs bzhi pa/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/

gnyis pa thabs sbyor ba bzhi la gnyis te/ dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras dang*/ brtan pa rgyu 'bras so/ /dang po dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras la gnyis te/ dbang du byed pa'i rgyu rnam kun/ dbang gyur thob pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba'o/ / dang po dbang du byed pa'i rnam kun la gnyis te/ sbyor ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ khyad par can no// dang po sbyor ba spyir bstan pa la bzhi/ sbyor ba'i yul rnam pa/ bsgom mkhan gang zag /sbyor ba'i rab dbye/ sngon 'gro'i chos so/ /dang po sbyor ba'i yul rnam pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams// rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de// kun mkhyen nyid ni rnam gsum phyir// de ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod// 1 ces so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ gzhi shes mdo bzhin bden bzhi la sbyar ba nyi shu rtsa bdun dang*/ lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug bstan pa dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'o/ /dang po gzhi shes mdo bzhin bden bzhi la sbyar ba nyi shu rtsa bdun ni/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste// mi g.yo ba yi rnam pa'i bar// bden pa so so la bzhi dang*// lam la de ni bco lngar bshad// 2 ces so// gnyis pa lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug ni/ rgyu dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang*// 'gog pa la ni go rims bzhin// de dag brgyad dang bdun dang ni// lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so// 3 ces so// gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag nas bzung ste// sangs rgyas rnam pa'i mthar thug rnams// lam gyi bden pa'i rjes mthun par// kun mkhyen gsum du phye bas na// 4 slob ma byang chub sems dpa' dang*// sangs rgyas rnams la rim bzhin du// sum cu bdun dang sum cu bzhi// sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu bzhed// 5 ces so// gnyis pa bsgom mkhyen gang zag ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas// de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun//

dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa// 'di mnyan pa yi snod yin no// 6 sangs rgyas bstan dang kun 'dri dang*// sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs spyod pas// len dang 'dzin la sogs pa yi// snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do// 7 ces so// gsum pa sbyor ba'i rab dbye ni/ gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir// de la sbyor ba bkag pa'i phyir// de yi de bzhin nyid zab phyir// de rnams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir// 8 de dag tshad ni med phyir dang*// tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i phyir// lung bstan phyir mi ldog nyid dang*// nges 'byung bar chad med bcad dang*// 9 byang chub nye dang myur ba dang*// gzhan don 'phel med 'grib med phyir// chos dang chos min sogs mi mthong*// gzugs sogs bsam mi khyab mi mthong*// 10 gzugs sogs de yi mtshan ma dang*// de yi ngo bor rnam mi rtog/ 'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed dang*// de ni dag pa mtshams dang bcas// 11 zhes so// bzhi pa sngon 'gro'i chos la bzhi/ sbyor ba'i yon tan/ sbyor ba'i skyon/ nus pa mtshan nyid/ thar pa cha mthun no/ /dang po yon tan ni/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa// yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi'o// zhes so// gnyis pa skyon ni/ skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa// drug tu nges par rtogs par bya// 12 zhes so// gsum pa nus pa mtshan nyid la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po mdor bstan ni/ gang gi mtshon te mtshan nyid du// shes bya de yang rnam pa gsum// shes pa khyad par byed pa ste// ngo bo nyid gang mtshon bya yang*// 13 zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la drug /shes pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag bcu drug gis thams cad shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ shes rnam bcu drug gis lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ shes rnam bcu drug gis rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid/ khyad par bcu drug gi mtshan nyid/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ de'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do/ /dang po shes pa'i bye brag bcu drug gis thams cad shes pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/

de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*// 'jig rten 'jig med bdag nyid dang*// sems can sems kyi spyod pa dang*// de bsdus pa dang phyir ltas dang*// 14 mi bzad pa yi rnam pa dang*// chags bcas sogs dang rgya chen dang*// chen por gyur dang tshad med dang*// rnam shes bstan du med pa dang*// 15 sems bltar med dang shes pa de// g.yo ba la sogs shes bya dang*// de las gzhan yang de dgani// de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par shes// 16 thub pas de bzhin nyid rtogs te// gzhan la bstan pa zhes bya 'di// thams cad shes pa nyid skabs kyi// shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa yin// 17 ces so// gnyis pa shes rnam bcu drug gis lam shes kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ stong nyid mtshan med bcas pa dang*// smon pa rnam par spangs pa dang*// skye med 'gag pa med sogs dang*// chos nyid rnam par 'khrug med dang*// 18 'du mi byed dang rnam mi rtog/ rab dbye mtshan nyid med nyid la// lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyis ni// shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par bzhed// 19 ces so// gsum pa shes rnam bcu drug gis rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ de ni nyid kyi chos bsten nas// gnas dang gus par bya ba dang*// bla ma nyid dang mnyes pa dang*// de la mchod dang byed med dang*// 20 kun tu 'jug mkhyen gang yin dang*// ma mthong ston par mdzad pa dang*// 'jig rten stong nyid rnam pa dang*// brjod dang shes mdzad mngon sum mdzad// 21 bsam mi khyab dang zhi nyid ston// 'jig rten 'du shes 'gog pa la// rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni// shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do// 22 zhes so// bzhi pa khyad par gyi mtshan nyid bcu drug bstan pa la/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis// khyad zhugs bden pa'i spyod yul can// skad cig ma ni bcu drug gis// khyad par mtshan nyid bshad pa yin// 23 zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/

bsam mi khyab dang mi mnyam dang*// gzhal dang bgrang las yang dag 'das// 'phags pa kun bsdus mkhas pa yis// rig bya thun mong min shes nyid// 24 shes myur bri dang gang med dang*// sgrub dang yang dag 'grub pa dang*// dmigs pa brten dang bcas pa dang*// mtha' dag pa dang yongs 'dzin dang*// 25 ro myang med dang khyad par ni// bcu drug bdag nyid ces bya ste// gang gis lam ni gzhan dag las// khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam// 26 ces so// lnga pa byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang*// mi rnams kyi ni skyabs dag dang*// gnas dang dpung gnyen gling dang ni// yongs 'dren pa zhes bya ba dang*// 27 lhun gyis grub dang theg gsum gyis// 'bras bu mngon sum mi byed dag/ tha ma rten gyi mdzad pa ste// 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin// 28 ces so// drug pa de'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni/ nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang*// mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dag/ dben dang dka' dang nges pa dang*// ched du bya dang mi dmigs dang*// 29 mngon par zhen pa bkag pa dang*// dmigs pa zhes bya gang yin dang*// mi mthun thogs pa med dang de// gzhi med 'gro med skye med dang*// 30 de bzhin nyid ni mi dmigs dang*// ngo bo nyid bcu drug bdag nyid// mtshon bya lta bur mtshon pas na// mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin// 31 ces so// bzhi pa thar pa cha mthun la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po mdor bstan ni/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs// yang dag sgrub la mkhas pa ni// rnam pa thams cad rtogs 'di la// thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod// 32 ces so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang*// sbyin sogs spyod yul brtson 'grus dang*// bsam pa phun tshogs dran pa dang*// rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin dang*// 33 chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du// shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam lnga// rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnon po yis//

rtogs sla rtul pos rtoḍa dkar bzhed// 34 ces so// gnyis pa khyad par can la gsum/ drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog gi bsgom pa'i gnas skabs/ gang zag /bsgom rim khyad par can no/ /dang po drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog gi bsgom pa'i gnas skabs ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir// sems can thams cad yin par bsngags// de dag nyid la sems mnyam sogs// rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do// 35 bdag nyid sdig pa las ldog cing*// sbyin la sogs la gnas pas gzhan// de dag la ni 'god pa dang*// bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// 36 rtser gyur de bzhin bzod pa ni// rang gzhan rten can bden shes pa// chos mchog de bzhin sems can rnams// smin byed sogs kyis shes par bya// 37 zhes so// gnyis pa gang zag la bzhi/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun mdor bstan/ sbyor lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags nyi shu/ mthong lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug/ bsgom lam gyi rtags so/ /dang po phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun mdor bstan pa ni/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste// mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag la// byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas// de 'dir mi ldog pa yi tshogs// 38 zhes so// gnyis pa sbyor lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags nyi shu bstan pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog sogs rtags// rnam pa nyi shur brjod pa yis// nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i// phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid 'di// 39 ces so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang*// the tshom mi dal zad pa dang*// bdag nyid dge ba la gnas shing*// gzhan dag de la 'god pa dang*// 40 gzhan gyi rten can sbyin sogs dang*// zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med// byams lus sogs dang sgrib pa ni// rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs dang*// 41 bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang*// dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang*//

gos la sogs pa gtsang ba dang*// lus la srin bu rnams mi 'byung*// 42 gya gyu med sems sbyangs pa ni// len dang ser sna med sogs dang*// chos nyid ldan par 'gro nyid dang*// sems can don du dmyal tshol dang*// 43 gzhan gyis bkri bar mi btub dang*// lam gzhan nye bar ston bdud la// bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang*// sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa ste// 44 rtags ni nyi shu de dag gis// drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang*// chos mchog rnams la gnas pa ni// rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog/ 45 ces so// gsum pa mthong lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po mdor bstan ni/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*// shes pa'i skad cig bcu drug ni// byang chub sems dpa' mi ldog pa'i// mtshan nyid yin par shes par bya// 46 zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad ni/ gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa dang*// sems brten theg pa dman dag las// rnam log bsam gtan la sogs pa'i// yan lag yongs su zad pa dang*// 47 lus sems yang ba nyid dang ni// 'dod la spyod la thabs mkhas dang*// rtag tu tshangs par spyod nyid dang*// 'tsho ba rnam par dag nyid dang*// 48 phung sogs bar chad byed rnams dang*// tshogs dang dbang sogs bcas pa yi// g.yul 'gyed ser sna la sogs la// sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba yi// 49 gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*// chos ni rdul tsam mi dmigs nyid// rang gi sa la nges pa nyid// sa gsum la ni gnas pa dang*// 50 chos kyi don du srog gtong ba// de 'dra'i skad cig bcu drug ni// blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas pa'i// phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin// 51 zhes so// bzhi pa bsgom lam gyi rtags la brgyad de/ bsgom lam gi khyad par/ khyad par gyi gzhi/ dbye ba/ grangs med pa bstan pa mi 'gal ba/ bsgom lam gyi byed pa/ 'bras bu la rtsod pa dgod pa/ lan dpe dang bcas pa/ zab mo brgyad kyis rtags nyid bstan pa'o/

/dang po bsgom lam gyi khyad par bstan pa ni/ sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste// zab mo stong pa nyid la sogs// zab pa de ni sgro 'dogs dang*// skur pa'i mtha' las grol ba nyid// 52 ces so// gnyis pa khyad gzhi bstan pa ni/ nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i// lam dang sgom pa'i lam nyid la// yang dang yang du sems pa dang*// 'jal dang nges rtog sgom pa'i lam// 53 zhes so// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ de ni rgyun chags yin pa'i phyir// chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams// chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis// rnam pas rnam pa dgur bzhed do// 54 ces so// bzhi pa grangs med pa bstan pa mi 'gal ba ni/ grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams// dam pa'i don du bzod ma yin// kun rdzob tu ni thugs brtse bas// rgyu mthun de dag thub pa bzhed// 55 ces so// lnga pa bsgom lam gyi byed pa la/ brgal ba dang*/ lan gnyis/ dang po brgal ba ni/ dngos po brjod du med pa la// nyams pa dang ni 'phel mi rung*// sgom zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni// ci zhig nyams shing ci zhig 'thob// 56 ces so// gnyis pa lan ni/ byang chub ji lta de bzhin du// 'di ni 'dod pa'i don sgrub byed// byang chub de bzhin nyid mtshan nyid// de yang de yi mtshan nyid bzhed// 57 ces so// drug pa 'bras bu la rtsod pa dgod pa ni/ sems ni snga mas byang chub par// rigs min phyi mas kyang ni min// zhes so// bdun pa lan dpe dang bcas pa ni/ mar me'i dpe yi tshul gyis ni// zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad// 58 ces so// brgyad pa zab mo brgyad kyi rtags nyid bstan pa ni/ skye ba dang ni 'gag pa dang*// de bzhin nyid dang shes bya dang*// shes dang spyod dang gnyis med dang*// thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid// 59 ces so// gsum pa bsgom rim khyad par can la gsum/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba/ thabs mkhas pa'i sbyor ba bcu bsgom pa'o/ /dang po srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba ni/

chos rnams rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir// srid dang zhi bar mi rtog pa// las med la sogs klan ka yi// lan ni ji skad bshad par zad// 60 ces so// gnyis pa zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba ni/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du// snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa// de la dag par sgrub pa yis// sangs rgyas zhing ni dag pa nyid// 61 ces so// gsum pa thabs mkhas pa'i sbyor ba ni/ yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni// dgra rnams las ni 'das pa dang*// mi shes ji bzhin shugs dang ni// thun mong ma yin mtshan nyid dang*// 62 ma chags pa dang mi dmigs dang*// mtshan ma smon lam zad pa dang*// de yi rtags dang tshad med pa// thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa bcu// 63 zhes so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ skabs bzhi pa'o// // skabs lnga pa/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ gnyis pa dbang gyur thob pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba la gnyis/ gnyen po rtse mo/ spang bya log sgrub bo/ /dang po gnyen po rtse mo la bzhi/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ bsgom lam/ bar chad med lam rtse mo'o/ /dang po sbyor lam la bzhi/ drod kyi rtse mo rtags kyi mtshon pa/ rtse mo'i rtse mo rnam par 'phel ba/ bzod pa'i rtse mo bstan pa/ chos mchog gi rtse mo sems kun tu gnas pa'o/ /dang po drod kyi rtse sbyor rtags kyis mtshon pa ni/

rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun// rmi lam lta bur lta la sogs// rtse mor phyin par sbyor ba'i rtags// rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed// 1 ces so// gnyis pa rtse mo'i rtse mo rnam par 'phel ba ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo rnyed// sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge la sogs// rnam mang du ni dper mdzad nas// rnam 'phel bcu drug bdag nyid do// 2 zhes so// gsum pa bzod pa'i rtse mo bstan pa ni/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi// yongs su rdzogs pa bla med pa// sems can don yongs mi gtong ba// brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod// 3 ces so// bzhi pa chos mchog gi rtse sems kun tu gnas pa ni/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang*// stong gnyis gsum dag dper mdzad nas// bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni// ting 'dzin yongs su bsgrags pa yin// 4 zhes so// gnyis pa mthong lam rtse mo la drug /spang bya rnam rtog /skye ba'i rgyu grogs/ 'bras bu byang chub/ rtse mo'i byed pa/ ngo bo/ /de'i bsgom pa'o// dang po rnam rtog la bzhi ste/ gzung rtog mdor bstan/ 'dzin rtog mdor bstan/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i nges pa/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po gzung rtog mdor bstan pa ni/ 'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la// gzung ba'i rnam rtog so sor de// dgu yi bdag nyid ji bzhin yul// min pa'i bdag nyid dag shes bya// 5 zhes so// gnyis pa 'dzin rtog mdor bstan ni/ so so'i skye bo 'phags dbye bas// sems can rdzas dang btags yod par// rnam rtog 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod// de dag so sor dgu bdag nyid// 6 zhes so// gsum pa gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i nges pa ni/ gal te gzung don de bzhin med// de dag gang gi 'dzin par 'dod// de ltar de dag 'dzin pa yi// ngo bos stong pa'i mtshan nyid do// 7 zhes so// bzhi pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ 'jug pa'i gzung rtog dgu /ldog pa'i gzung rtog dgu /skyes bu rdzas 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu

/btags 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu'o/ /dang po 'jug pa'i gzung rtog dgu ni/ ngo bo nyid dang rigs dang ni// lam ni yang dag 'grub pa dang*// shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul dang*// mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dang*// 8 rang gis rtogs dang byed pa dang*// de yi las bya'i 'bras bu la// 'jug pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi// rnam rtog de ni rnam dgur 'dod// 9 ces so// gnyis pa ldog pa'i gzung rtog dgu ni/ srid dang zhi bar ltung ba'i phyir// rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni// yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang*// lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang dang*// 10 gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba dang*// ched du bya ba log pa dang*// nyi tshe ba dang sna tshogs nyid// gnas dang 'jug la rmongs pa dang*// 11 rjes la 'gro zhes bya ba la// rnam rtog dgu yi bdag nyid 'di// ldog pa'i phyogs kyi rten can te// nyan thos la sogs yid la 'byung*// 12 zhes so// gsum pa skyes bu rdzas 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu ni/ 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang*// yid la byed dang khams rnams ni// gsum po dag dang nye 'brel dang*// gnas dang mngon par zhen pa dang*// 13 chos kyi dngos po brtags pa dang*// chags pa dang ni gnyen po dang*// ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro nyams la// 'dzin pa dang por shes par bya// 14 zhes so// bzhi pa skyes bu btags 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu ni/ ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung dang*// lam la lam min nges 'dzin dang*// 'gag dang bcas pa'i skye ba dang*// dngos po ldan dang mi ldan dang*// 15 gnas dang rigs ni 'dzin pa dang*// don du gnyer dang rgyu med dang*// phyir rgol ba ni dmigs pa la// 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin no// 16 zhes so// gnyis pa skye ba'i rgyu grogs ni/ byang chub la gzhan ston pa dang*// de yi rgyu ni yongs gtong dang*// de thob bar chad med pa'i rgyu// bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid do// 17 zhes so// gsum pa 'bras bu byang chub chen po ni/

dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i// ye shes byang chub ces brjod do// zad med skye med phyir de dag/ go rims bzhin du shes par bya// 18 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni// rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad// skye med rnam pa ci zhig 'thob// 19 gzhan gyis chos rnams kyang yod la// shes bya la yang ston pa yi// sgrib pa zad par brjod pa gang*// de la kho bos mtshar du brtsis// 20 zhes so// bzhi pa rtse mo'i byed pa ni/ 'di las bsal bya ci yang med// gzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// 21 zhes so// lnga pa mthong lam rtse sbyor ngo bo ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re rer ni// de dag phan tshun bsdus pa gang*// skad cig gcig pa'i bzod pa yis// bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam// 22 zhes so// drug pa de'i bsgom pa ni/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i// ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas// rten cing 'brel 'byung lugs mthun dang*// lugs mi mthun la rtog par byed// 23 zhes so// gsum pa bsgom lam la gsum ste/ rten sgom pa'i lam/ spang bya rnam rtog /rten pa yon tan no/ /dang po rten sgom pa'i lam ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur// rnam pa gnyis su song 'ongs nas// thod rgal du ni snyoms 'jug pa// 'dod par gtogs pa'i rnam par shes// 24 mnyam gzhag min pa'i mtshams bzung ste// gcig dang gnyis gsum bzhi dang lnga// drug dang bdun dang brgyad rgal nas// 'gog pa'i bar du mi 'drar 'gro/ 25 zhes so// gnyis pa spang bya rnam rtog la gnyis te/ gzung rtog dang*/ 'dzin rtog go/ dang po gzung rtog la gnyis te/ 'jug pa gzung rtog dang*/ ldog pa gzung rtog /dang po 'jug pa gzung rtog ni/ mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi// btang bas yongs su ma bzung dang*// dus gsum yon tan med pa dang*// legs pa'i lam ni rnam gsum la//

26 bzung ba'i rnam rtog 'di gcig ste// sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i spyod yul can// zhes so// gnyis pa ldog pa gzung rtog ni/ gnyis pa sems dang sems byung rnams// 'jug pa'i yul can yin bzhed de// 27 sems mi skye dang byang chub kyi// snying po yid la mi byed dang*// theg pa dman pa yid byed dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid mi byed// 28 sgom dang sgom pa med pa dang*// de dag las ni bzlog nyid dang*// ji bzhin don min rnam rtog pa// sgom pa'i lam la shes par bya// 29 zhes so// gnyis pa 'dzin rtog la gnyis te/ sbyor ba'i yul can gyi 'dzin rtog dgu/ 'jug pa'i yul can gyi 'dzin rtog dgu'o/ /dang po sbyor ba'i yul can gyi 'dzin rtog dgu ni/ sems can btags pa'i spyod yul dang*// chos btags pa dang stong min nyid// chags dang rab 'byed bdag nyid dang*// dngos por byed dang theg gsum dang*// 30 yon ni dag pa ma yin dang*// spyod pa rnam par 'khrug pa la// 'dzin par byed pa dang por te// shes par bya ba bsgrags pa yin// 31 zhes so// gnyis pa 'jug pa'i yul can gyi 'dzin rtog dgu la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po mdor bstan ni/ sems can btags dang de'i rgyu yi// yul can de yis rnam 'joms pas// sgom pa'i lam dang 'brel pa yi// mi mthun phyogs gzhan rnam pa dgu/ 32 zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ bdag nyid ji bzhin kun mkhyen ni// gsum gyi sgrib pa rnam gsum dang*// zhi lam de bzhin nyid sogs dang*// mtshungs par ldan dang mi ldan dang*// 33 mi mnyam sdug bsngal la sogs dang*// nyon mongs rnams kyi rang bzhin dang*// gnyis su med dang kun rmongs la// rnam par rtog pa tha mar bzhed// 34 zhes so// gsum pa rten pa yon tan ni/ yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni// yun ring lon nas dbugs phyin ltar// rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi// bde sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun//

35 rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin// 'bras bu mchog gis sba ba yis// sems dpa' chen po de la ni// rnam pa kun tu rten par byed// 26 ces so// bzhi pa bar chad med pa rtse mo la gsum/ dpe dang*/ rang ldog ngos gzung ba dang*/ dmigs pa bdag po rnam par bstan pa'o/ /dang po dpe ni/ stong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang*// bse ru'i rtogs pa phun tshogs dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med la// bkod pa'i dge ba dper mdzad nas// 37 bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni// sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar med de// ces so// gnyis pa rang ldog ngos bzung ba ni/ bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin// de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid// 38 ces so// gsum pa dmigs pa bdag po rnam par bstan pa ni/ 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de// bdag po dran pa yin par bzhed// rnam pa zhi nyid ces so// gnyis pa spang bya log bsgrub la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ 'di la ni// rab tu smra rnams brgyud mar rgol// 39 zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ dmigs pa 'thad dang de yi ni// ngo bo nyid nges bzung ba dang*// rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes dang*// dam pa'i don dang kun rdzob dang*// 40 sbyor dang dkon mchog gsum po dang*// thabs bcas thub pa'i rtogs pa dang*// phyin ci log ni lam bcas dang*// gnyen po mi mthun phyogs dag dang*// 41 mtshan nyid dang ni sgom pa la// smra ba rnams kyis log rtog pa// rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid rten can// rnam pa bcu drug dag tu bzhed// 42 ces so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ skabs lnga pa'o// // skabs drug pa/ mthar gyis sbyor ba/ gnyis pa brtan pa rgyu 'bras la gnyis te/ rgyu mthar gyis pa dang*/ 'bras bu skad cig ma'o/

/dang po rgyu mthar gyis pa la gnyis ste/ lam gang la brten nas/ gang 'grub pa'o/ /dang po lam gang la brten nas ni/ sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang*// sangs rgyas la sogs dran dang chos// dngos med ngo bo nyid kyis de// zhes so// gnyis pa gang 'grub pa ni/ mthar gyis pa yi bya bar bzhed// 1 ces so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ skabs drug pa'o// // skabs bdun pa/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ gnyis pa 'bras bu skad cig ma la bzhi ste/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'o/ /dang po rnam smin ma yin pa'i skad cig ma la gnyis te/ don dgod pa dang*/ de nyid dpes sgrub pa'o/ /dang po don dgod pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang*// zag med chos kun bsdus pa'i phyir// thub pa'i skad cig gcig pa yis// rtogs pa 'di ni shes par bya// 1 zhes so// gnyis pa de nyid dpes sgrub pa ni/ ji ltar skyes bus zo chun rgyud// rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na// thams cad cig car 'gul ba ltar// skad cig gcig shes de bzhin no// 2 zhes so// gnyis pa rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma ni/ gang tshe chos dkar thams cad kyi// rang bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin// rnam smin chos nyid gnas skabs skyes// de tshe skad cig gcig ye shes// 3 zhes so// gsum pa mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma ni/ sbyin la sogs pa'i spyod pa yis// chos kun rmi lam 'drar gnas nas// chos rnams mtshan nyid med pa nyid// skad cig ma ni gcig gis rtogs// 4 zhes so// bzhi pa gnyis su med pa'i skad gcig ma ni/ rmi lam dang ni de mthong nyid// gnyis kyi tshul du mi mthong ltar// chos rnams gnyis su med pa yi// de nyid skad cig gcig gis mthong*// 5 zhes so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/

skabs bdun pa'o// // skabs brgyad pa/ 'bras bu chos sku/ ༄༅/ /gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku la lnga ste/ ngo bo nyid/ chos dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ sprul pa'i sku dang*/ chos sku'i mdzad pa'o/ /dang po ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni// zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag/ thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa// de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can// 1 zhes so// gnyis pa chos sku la drug /chos rnams kyi rnam pa bshad pa/ nyan thos kyi nyon mongs pa med pa las khyad par/ smon nas mkhyen pa'i khyad par/ phrin las 'jug pa'i tshul/ ma nges pa spang ba/ khyab pa dang rtag pa'i don no/ /dang po chos rnams kyi rnam pa bshad pa ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*// rnam par thar dang mthar gyis ni// snyoms 'jug dgu yi bdag nyid dang*// zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang*// 2 zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni// rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang*// nyon mongs med dang smon mkhyen dang*// mngon shes so so yang dag rig/ 3 rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang*// dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang*// mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang*// bsrung ba med pa rnam gsum dang*// 4 dran pa nyer gzhag rnam gsum dang*// bsnyel ba mi mnga'i chos nyid dang*// bag chags yang dag bcom pa dang*// skye la thugs rje chen po dang*// 5 thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos// bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang*// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*// chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// 6 zhes so// gnyis pa nyan thos kyi nyon mongs pa med pa las khyad par bstan pa ni/ nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta// nyan thos nyon mongs yongs spong nyid// grong sogs su de'i nyon mongs rnams// rgyun gcod rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med// 7 ces so// gsum pa smon nas mkhyen pa'i khyad par ni/ sangs rgyas smon nas mkhyen pa ni// lhun gyis grub dang chags spangs dang*// thogs pa med dang rtag gnas dang*//

dri ba kun lan 'debs par bzhed// 8 ces so// bzhi pa phrin las 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ rgyu ni yongs su smin gyur nas// gang dang gang la gang dang ni// gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa// de dang de la de snang ngo*// 9 ces so// lnga pa ma nges pa spang ba ni/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*// sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar// sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur kyang*// skal ba med pas bzang mi myong*// 10 ces so// drug pa khyab pa dang rtag pa'i don ni/ de ltar mdzad pa rgya che'i phyir// sangs rgyas khyab par nges par brjod// de nyid zad pa med pa'i phyir// rtag pa zhes kyang brjod pa yin// 11 ces so// gsum pa longs sku la lnga ste/ mdor bstan pa/ mtshan bzang po bshad pa/ ji ltar 'grub pa/ rgyu mdo la sbyar ba/ dpe byad bshad pa'o/ /dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid 'di// theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir//

thub pa'i longs spyod rdzoḍa skur bzhed// 12 ces so// gnyis pa mtshan bzang po bshad pa ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs// phyag dang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel pa dang*// phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags// 'di yi sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang*// 13 sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang*// zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs// byin pa e na ya'i 'dra phyag ring mdzes// mdoms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog/ 14 pags pa gser mdog pags pa srab pa dang*// spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang*// zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge 'dra// 'di yi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas// 15 'di la ro mi zhim pa ro mchog snang*// sku ni n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab// gtsug tor dbur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang*// tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra dang tshems// 16 shin tu dkar dang tshed mnyam thags bzang dang*// grangs ni bzhi bcu tham par tshang ba dang*// spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rdzi ba mchog gi/ 'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// 17 zhes so// gsum pa ji ltar 'grub pa ni/ 'di la mtshan ni gang gang gis// sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin// de dang de ni rab rdzogs pas// mtshan ni 'di dag yang dag 'grub// 18 ces so// bzhi pa rgyu mdo la sbyar ba ni/ bla ma skyel la sogs pa dang*// yang dag blangs pa brtan pa dang*// bsdu ba bsten dang gya nom pa'i// dngos po sbyin dang gsad bya ba// 19 thar bar byed dang dge ba ni// yang dag blangs pa spel la sogs// sgrub byed rgyu yi mtshan nyid de// mdo las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin// 20 zhes so// lnga pa dpe byad bshad pa ni/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*// mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams// zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang*// rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med// 21 long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang*// seng ge glang chen bya dang ni//

khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang*// mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags// 22 byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham// gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku// mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang*// 23 gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni// dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang*// sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang*// shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*// 24 yan lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang*// gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang*// dku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs dang*// phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni// 25 zab dang g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang*// kun nas blta na sdug pa dang*// kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni// sme ba gnag bag med pa dang*// 26 phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang*// phyag ris mdangs yod zab ring dang*// zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang*// mchu ni bim+pa ltar dmar dang*// 27 ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang*// dmar dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang*// gsung mnyen 'jam dang mche ba zlum// rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang*// 28 byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang*// mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni// spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang*// 29 smin tshugs ring dang 'jam pa dang*// snum dang spu ni mnyam pa dang*// phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang*// nyams pa rnam par spangs pa dang*// 30 dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang*// dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang*// dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang*// stug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzings dang*// 31 mi bshor dri zhim skyes bu yi// yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang*// dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni// g.yung drung 'khyil bas brgyan pa ste// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed// 32 ces so// bzhi pa sprul sku la gsum/ dus dang*/ gang gi don dang*/ rgyun mi chad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po dus ni/ gang gi srid pa ji srid par// zhes so// gnyis pa gang gi don mdzad pa ni/ 'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag/ mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni//

zhes so// gsum pa rgyun mi chad pa'i tshul ni/ thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad// 33 ces so// lnga pa chos sku'i mdzad pa ni gsum/ dang po 'jug yul rgyun mi 'chad pa/ phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po 'jug yul rgyun mi 'chad pa ni/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i// las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun bshad pa ni/ 'gro rnam zhi ba'i las dang ni// bsdu rnam bzhi la 'god pa dang*// 34 kun nas nyon mongs bcas pa yi// rnam par byang ba rtogs pa dang*// sems can rnams don ji bzhin gyi// don dang pha rol phyin drug dang*// 35 sangs rgyas lam dang rang bzhin gyis// stong pa nyid dang gnyis zad dang*// brda dang dmigs pa med pa dang*// lus can rnams ni yongs smin dang*// 36 byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ni// mngon par zhen pa zlog pa dang*// byang chub thob dang sangs rgyas zhing*// rnam par dag dang nges pa dang*// 37 sems can don ni tshad med dang*// sangs rgyas rten sogs yon tan dang*// byang chub yan lag las rnams ni// chud mi za dang bden mthong dang*// 38 phyin ci log ni spangs pa dang*// de gzhi med pa'i tshul dang ni// rnam par byang dang tshogs dang ni// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa la// 39 tha dad yongs su mi shes dang*// mya ngan 'das la 'god pa ste// chos kyi sku yi phrin las ni// rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed// 40 ces so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas ba las/ skabs brgyad pa'o// // gsum pa mjug gi don/ bsdus don rnam grangs gzhan bstan pa la gnyis/ drug tu bshad pa/ gsum du bsdu ba'o/ /dang po drug tu bshad pa ni/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang*// de rab de yi go rims dang*// de mtha' de yi rnam smin ni// don bsdus gzhan de rnam pa drug/ 1 ces so// gnyis pa grangs gsum du bsdu ba ni/

yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu// sbyor ba bzhi yi bdag nyid dang*// chos sku phrin las 'bras bu ni// don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum// 2 ces so/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtoḍa pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po bid+ya ka ra pra bha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal go mi 'chi med la sogs pa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// // rgyal yum pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung rnams kun// rgyal sras ma pham pa yis brgyan byas pa// rgyal ba'i mdo bzhin mkhas grub rnams kyis phye// bod 'dir snga rabs 'das pa'i mkhas rnams kyis// blo gros ldan pa'i rgyas bsdus du ma byas// phyi dus tshig nyung rnam bshad mang byas pas// bdag gi don bsdus dgos med ma yin nam// 'on kyang lung tsam dge ba'i bshes las thos// phyi dus lha steng dben pa byed pa'i tshe// rab rib 'khrul pa'i gnyid kyi rmi lam nang*// steng phyogs mnyam pa sa yi dbus na ni// khang brtsegs mdzes na rgyal ba'i mchod rten drung*// dge ba'i bshes bzhuḍa gsum gyis mgrin gcig tu// pha rol phyin pa gzhung 'di gsungs pa thos// sad tshe blo la rab tu gsal bar snang*// de phyir 'di la mos pa rgya cher skyes// rnam bshad byas kyang 'jug par byed med pas// mngon rtogs snang byed don bsdus tshig 'di dang*// skabs brgyad stong thun gnyis (karma pa rang byung rdo rjes )sbyar dge ba yis/ /myur du rgyal yum mngon du ston par shog/
